name: xpollinate
description: Multi-agent deliberation skills for Claude Code. Cross-check a judgment call instead of interrupting the user, or run a full adversarial protocol on a hard question.

plugins.name: xpollinate
plugins.description: Recommended. Both skills: xpollinate (pre-commit, control, stances, red team, cross-pollination, synthesis for hard or high-stakes questions) and xcheck (decide a judgment call with a two-agent cross-check instead of asking).

plugins.name: xcheck
plugins.description: Only xcheck, the lightweight one. Fires on its own whenever Claude is about to interrupt you with a judgment call it could make itself: two or three agents decide from different vantage points, argue, and escalate to you only if they cannot converge.
